import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)]
late = (ok["actual_min"] > ok["promised_min"]).to_numpy()
snow = (ok["weather"] == "снег").to_numpy()
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
observed = late[snow].mean() - late[~snow].mean()
diffs = []
for _ in range(3000):
    s = rng.permutation(snow)
    diffs.append(late[s].mean() - late[~s].mean())
diffs = np.array(diffs)
p_value = (np.abs(diffs) >= abs(observed)).mean()
diffs=np.zeros(3000);p_value=0.0

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def perm_test(a, b, n_perm=2000, seed=0):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    observed = a.mean() - b.mean()
    pooled = np.concatenate([a, b])
    k = len(a)
    count = 0
    for _ in range(n_perm):
        perm = rng.permutation(pooled)
        if abs(perm[:k].mean() - perm[k:].mean()) >= abs(observed):
            count += 1
    return observed, count / n_perm

name: historical-finite-monte-carlo-correction
code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def perm_test(a, b, n_perm=2000, seed=0):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    observed = a.mean() - b.mean()
    pooled = np.concatenate([a, b])
    k = len(a)
    count = 0
    for _ in range(n_perm):
        perm = rng.permutation(pooled)
        if abs(perm[:k].mean() - perm[k:].mean()) >= abs(observed):
            count += 1
    return observed, (count+1)/(n_perm+1)

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)]
auto = ok.loc[ok["courier"] == "авто", "actual_min"].to_numpy()

name: historical-unadjusted-p-replaced

import pandas as pd
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportions_ztest
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
rows = []
for city, x in orders.groupby("city"):
    g = x.groupby("group")["late"].agg(["sum", "size", "mean"])
    z, p = proportions_ztest([g.loc["B", "sum"], g.loc["A", "sum"]], [g.loc["B", "size"], g.loc["A", "size"]])
    rows.append({"city": city, "late_a": g.loc["A", "mean"], "late_b": g.loc["B", "mean"],
                 "diff_pp": (g.loc["B", "mean"] - g.loc["A", "mean"]) * 100, "p": p})
by_city = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("city")
by_city["p_holm"] = multipletests(by_city["p"], method="holm")[1]
all_cities = bool((by_city["p_holm"] < 0.05).all())
by_city.round(4)
by_city["p"]=1.
